data.split_policy: Reuse stage-02 train/test splits without modification for matched experiments.
data.validation_policy: Create validation subsets from training data only; never tune on the stage-02 test split.
data.test_policy: Evaluate the locked final configuration once per seed on the held-out test split.

randomness.confirmatory_scope: Key proposed-versus-best-baseline comparisons after all three primary seeds finish.

training.initialization: Stage-04 trained EcoTrust encoder for every matched neural federated method.

statistics.paired_test: Wilcoxon signed-rank when at least five paired observations exist; otherwise paired permutation test.

protocol_amendment.scope: FedAdam only; completed FedAvg and FedProx runs are unchanged.
protocol_amendment.reason: The original implementation used an implicit server learning rate of 1.0 and produced non-finite probabilities on the first FedAdam run. The corrected conservative server learning rate is fixed before any valid FedAdam metric was observed.

10.name: non_iid_dropout_scalability
10.dropout_definition: A selected client becomes unavailable before local training and consumes no round energy or communication.
10.straggler_definition: A selected available client completes local training but its update misses the aggregation deadline; its compute energy is counted and its update is excluded.
10.design: One-factor-at-a-time around the registered primary setting, plus the hardest joint setting.

execution.assignment: Deterministic modulo assignment over the registered run-key order.
execution.protocol_effect: Scheduling only; no scientific setting, seed, round, metric, or artifact is changed.

11.name: temporal_drift_and_forgetting
11.stream_policy: Use chronological order when a defensible timestamp exists; otherwise use documented acquisition/source order and label it source-order drift.

12.name: malicious_client_robustness
12.scope: Deterministic full-factorial sensitivity matrix; multi-seed primary inference is performed in stage 09.
12.parameter_attack_scope: Sign flip, model scaling, and Gaussian attacks modify trainable parameter deltas only. BatchNorm running statistics and other registered buffers retain their matched local-training values.

protocol_amendment.scope: Stage 12 only; Stage 10, 11, 13, and 14 results are unchanged.
protocol_amendment.reason: The original partial Stage-12 implementation transformed all floating state-dict tensors, including BatchNorm running variance. This produced invalid negative variance and non-finite predictions unrelated to the registered trainable-parameter update attacks. The corrected protocol is versioned, preserves the failed v1 evidence, and restarts the full matched Stage-12 matrix in a separate output namespace.

execution.assignment: Deterministic modulo assignment over the registered run-key order.
execution.protocol_effect: Scheduling only; no scientific setting, seed, round, metric, or artifact is changed.
execution.gpu_class_requirement: Use one consistent GPU class across all three Stage-12 shards. If three matching GPUs are unavailable, run the shards sequentially on the same GPU class.

execution_amendment.reason: Repeated Colab CPU runtime disconnections made the remaining full Stage-12 matrix impractical. The user explicitly authorized GPU continuation.
execution_amendment.scope: Execution backend only. Registered data, splits, attacks, fractions, aggregators, seed, rounds, local epochs, local batch size, metrics, output namespace, and poisoning protocol remain unchanged.
execution_amendment.resume_policy: Retain completed CPU runs. Resume interrupted CPU checkpoints on CUDA with local batch size fixed at 256. Persist device history so mixed-backend runs are not mislabeled as GPU-only.

13.name: cross_dataset_controller_generalization
13.protocol: Leave one dataset out: train controller policy on telemetry from two datasets and evaluate policy decisions on the held-out dataset without refitting.

14.name: resource_energy_policy_comparison
14.scope: Matched policy sensitivity comparison; stage 09 provides the primary multi-seed inference.

measurement.fallback: Calibrated energy estimate reported explicitly as estimated, never as direct measurement.

integrity.completion_rule: A stage is complete only when its manifest is completed and every registered required artifact validates.
